''See also: [[Akura Fury Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura clan|Akura]] [[Fury]] is a legendary figure within the [[Akura clan]], known for his immense strength and status as a [[Herald]]. A man of intense emotion and combat prowess, he is characterized by his red eyes, bare chest, and black hair that moves like flames or seaweed. He is described as a combatant who finds joy in battle, often exulting in conflict and using his anger as a weapon. Historically, he achieved significant success by winning a [[tournament]], earning him legendary status. While he possesses the signature [[shadow madra]] of his lineage, he has also been seen wearing the white armor of the [[Abidan]] and utilizing the techniques of the [[Wolf Division]]. Throughout his long life, he has demonstrated a personality that ranges from boisterous and childishly disappointed to deadly serious. He is part of a family known for their Shadow{{!}}shadow-based powers and intimidating presence, which includes relatives such as [[Akura Charity]], [[Akura Malice]], and [[Akura Mercy]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura clan|Akura]] [[Fury]] possesses crimson eyes and wild, shadowy hair. He is seen wearing the seamless white armor of the [[Abidan]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Described as uncontrollable, he tends to shirk his duties unless they pertain to combat or personal [[advancement]]. He is a quick-to-adapt individual who showed curiosity regarding [[Lindon]]'s suggestion.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura clan|Akura]] [[Fury]] is the uncle of [[Mercy]]. He served as a teacher to [[Lindon]], instructing him on how to layer techniques. Additionally, he has crossed blows with [[Redmoon]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A [[Herald]] advancing to [[Monarch]], he utilizes [[shadow madra]] and has the capacity to layer techniques. His skills include a [[technique]] that produces a blue circular doorway to another world using a substance resembling a patchwork of every shade of blue.}}
